info.name: CYCLES_SURFACE_COMPOSITING
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: per-surface ray-visibility flags plus holdout / shadow-catcher compositing controls, mapping onto Cycles Object sockets. Each 'visible.*' flag defaults to the core 'visible' parameter, so 'visible' toggles all ray types at once while individual flags override it (e.g. visible=false + visible.shadow=true keeps only the shadows). Instanced surfaces share their ANARI Surface, so these flags apply identically to every instance.

parameters.name: visible.camera
parameters.description: surface is visible to camera (primary) rays; defaults to 'visible'

parameters.name: visible.diffuse
parameters.description: surface is visible to diffuse reflection rays; defaults to 'visible'

parameters.name: visible.glossy
parameters.description: surface is visible to glossy/specular reflection rays; defaults to 'visible'

parameters.name: visible.transmission
parameters.description: surface is visible to transmission (refraction) rays; defaults to 'visible'

parameters.name: visible.shadow
parameters.description: surface casts shadows (visible to shadow rays); defaults to 'visible'

parameters.name: visible.volumeScatter
parameters.description: surface is visible to volume scattering rays; defaults to 'visible'

parameters.name: holdout
parameters.description: render the surface as a holdout matte: it cuts a hole (zero alpha over a transparent background) in the frame while still blocking and reflecting light in the rest of the scene

parameters.name: shadowCatcher
parameters.description: render the surface as a shadow catcher: it is transparent except where it catches shadows from other objects, for compositing renders over live footage (pair with a transparent 'background')
